name: Vampire - Regeneration - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a feature

results.text: The vampire's withered flesh trembles as it reaches for the lifeblood coursing through its veins.
A guttural hiss escapes its lips as the undead creature prepares to reclaim its stolen vitality.
The moonlight flickers as the vampire clutches its chest, yearning for forgotten strength.
Its hollow eyes gleam with hunger as it draws upon the dark magic of immortality.
A cold wind howls through the chamber as the vampire's form shivers in anticipation.
